core_claims.name: Truth / truthEquality / equalityTruth / leBool / boolToLE / leToBool
core_claims.scope: Truth interpretation of Boolean values and equivalence with equality to True; the recursive natural comparison is sound and complete for LE on all inputs.

core_claims.name: decLE / decLT / decNatEq
core_claims.scope: Total positive/negative proof-producing decisions for natural non-strict order, strict order, and equality, without bounded search.

core_claims.name: decBool / toWitness / fromWitness / reflectedLE
core_claims.scope: Decision erasure, witness recovery from its Boolean truth, truth forced by an existing witness, and agreement of erased decLE with leBool for all naturals.

core_claims.name: decAnd / decOr / decNot / decImplies / decIff / andErasure / orErasure / notErasure / impliesErasure / iffErasure
core_claims.scope: Constructive decisions for five logical connectives from component decisions, and exact Boolean truth-table erasure laws for every supplied pair of decisions.

core_claims.name: minus / safeMinus / safeMinusExample / FalseDecision / fromFalse / toFalse
core_claims.scope: Subtraction requiring LE evidence, reflected implicit precondition, checked 5-3=2, and both directions of negative-decision reflection.

core_claims.name: decOne / decCanonical / canonicalDecisionExamples
core_claims.scope: Total decisions for leading-one and canonical predicates over all finite raw bitstrings, including leading-zero counterexamples.

deviations: Uses the standard Idris Dec datatype and implicit auto argument search instead of Agda instance arguments.
Duplicate Boolean-derived and decision-derived comparison wrappers are consolidated into leBool, decLE, their two evidence bridges, and the universal reflectedLE agreement theorem.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: Recorded separately by the primary editor and independent reviewer
